notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
description:
At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, Mystic Barrier and Mirrormade trigger, choosing "left" for Mystic Barrier and "right" for Mirrormade.
As long as there are three or more players in the game, creatures cannot attack.

uses.name: Mirrormade
uses.cardState: as a copy of Mystic Barrier
